invariant: Dispensing fails closed to the veterinarian. pharmacy_operator is retired and must not return to any live authorization path.
note: W0-F acceptance criterion 3 says the retired role must appear nowhere in the tree. Taken literally that is unachievable and undesirable: the guards that forbid the role must name it, and the governance record that retires it must quote it. The enforceable form of AC3 is therefore: ZERO occurrences in live source, and every occurrence outside live source explicitly registered here with a reason. tests/governance/test_retired_role_absence.py enforces both halves.

needle_matching: CASE_INSENSITIVE, underscore required. A live grant could be reintroduced as PHARMACY_OPERATOR or Pharmacy_Operator, and a case-sensitive scan would report the tree clean — six such occurrences were invisible to the original guard and are registered below. The separator stays required: making it optional as well matched the ordinary English phrase 'pharmacy operator' across the governance prose (18 false positives), which would have driven the exclusion list to grow until the guard meant nothing. A wire role keeps its underscore; only its case can drift.
